checkbox.$description: Single size only (no sm/base/lg grid, per explicit spec — this isn't a field like Input/Select, it's a fixed-size control). Native <input type="checkbox"> stays in the DOM (visually hidden, not display:none) so keyboard/forms/screen-readers work for free — only its box is repainted via CSS, same approach Radix/MUI/Ant use. The checkmark and indeterminate dash are the Material icons already in assets/icons/material-filled (check.svg / remove.svg) — not a bespoke asset. Unchecked box stays on surface.default (not filled) so disabled's surface.disabled swap is an actual visible change, unlike Input where default and disabled already share the same gray.100 value.

radius.$description: 4px — noticeably tighter than radius.default (8px used by buttons/inputs/cards), the near-universal checkbox-corner convention across Material/Ant/MUI.

borderWidth.$description: 2px literal-equivalent (dim.0_5) — thicker than the 1px hairline used by Input/Select/Search because a 1px outline nearly disappears at a 20px box; same reasoning Material applies.

gap.$description: Box-to-label gap, 8px — same flat gap Button uses between its icon and label.

label.$description: 14px normal weight — the product's default UI text size, not the 16px form-value size (there's no Safari-zoom concern here, this is static text next to a control, not an editable field).

hover.$description: outline.strong (gray) read as too weak a hover cue in practice — same lesson learned building Card's interactive hover — so this uses fill.primary (blue.500) instead, same brand blue the checked state fills with.

focused.$description: Additive outline on top of whatever default/hover/checked look is already showing, same composable-ring pattern as Button.

checked.$description: Border set to the same value as bg (fill.primary) — the box reads as fully filled, no visible ring around the fill.

indeterminate.$description: Identical fill/border to checked — only the glyph differs (remove.svg dash instead of check.svg tick). Used for a parent 'select all' control when only some children are checked.

checkedHover.$description: Covers checked+hover and indeterminate+hover alike — fill.primaryHover (blue.600) is the exact same darken-on-hover Button primary already uses for its own filled background, reused here rather than inventing a separate darkening.

disabledChecked.$description: Covers disabled+checked and disabled+indeterminate alike — same fill.disabled/icon.disabled pair Button secondary/Input already use for their own disabled states.

group.$description: CheckboxGroup composes plain Checkbox items under an optional heading + helper text — no group-level error/validation state (not asked for; Checkbox itself has no error state either).

gapHorizontal.$description: 20px between items laid out in a row.

labelGap.$description: 8px between the group heading and the first item, and between helper text and the last item.
